title: My School Subjects
text:
My favorite school subject is English. We learn new words every day. The teacher is kind and she helps us a lot. English is fun.

On Monday we have maths. Maths is difficult for me, but I like numbers. On Friday we have art. We paint pictures and make things with paper.

questions.text: What is the student's favorite school subject?
What day do they have maths?
Which is the best guess about the student's English class?
options: The student feels comfortable and enjoys it
The class is always very loud
The student does not like the teacher

questions.text: What kind of person is the student most likely?

paragraph_translations: Mój ulubiony przedmiot w szkole to angielski. Uczymy się nowych słów każdego dnia. Nauczycielka jest miła i bardzo nam pomaga. Angielski jest zabawny.
W poniedziałek mamy matematykę. Matematyka jest dla mnie trudna, ale lubię liczby. W piątek mamy plastykę. Malujemy obrazki i robimy rzeczy z papieru.
